modules.description: Space-separated list of kernel modules to load before starting acpid; use "all" to load all acpi drivers, or leave empty/commented to load none Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#MODULES="battery ac processor button fan thermal video").

options.description: Additional command-line options to pass to acpid (as a string to be appended to the acpid command) Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#OPTIONS="").
